missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Поток' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'несёт'. 'Бурный' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'ветки' is the accusative plural object being carried.
Strategic focus: Accusative direction. 'Поток' is inanimate masculine accusative after 'в' marking transformation. 'Дождь' is the nominative subject, and 'ручей' is the accusative thing that changed.
Strategic focus: Genitive of attribution. 'Потока' is the genitive showing whose force is meant. 'Сила' is the nominative subject, and 'сломала' agrees with it in the feminine.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'По потоку' uses the dative after 'по' to express movement along the current. 'Лодку' is the accusative thing carried, and 'унесло' is impersonal.
Strategic focus: Dative of path. 'По бурному потоку' takes the dative after 'по' to mark the route. 'Бурному' agrees in the masculine dative, and 'плыли' describes the motion.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Потоком' is the instrumental marking the force that did the action. 'Воды' is the genitive describing the stream, and 'машину' is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В потоке' uses the prepositional 'потоке' after 'в' to show location within. 'Листья' is the nominative plural subject floating along.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after a number. After 'два' the noun takes the genitive singular 'потока'. 'Появилось' is the neuter impersonal verb, and 'после дождя' sets the time.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Потоки' is the nominative plural subject of 'текут'. 'Горные' agrees in the plural, and 'в долину' is the accusative of destination.

Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Потоки' is the inanimate masculine plural accusative, matching the nominative plural. 'Опасные' agrees in the plural, and 'переходили' takes them as objects.
